verdict.rationale: vLLM is a local LLM inference and serving engine, so built-in document chat with RAG is a fair question for this kind of tool. The evidence pack documents offline inference, an OpenAI-compatible server and tool calling, but nothing about document ingestion, indexing, retrieval or a chat-with-your-documents experience. These are only building blocks a developer could use to construct RAG, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
